# Revlet Console (app.revlet.me) — Complete Overview

> `Revlet Console` (`https://app.revlet.me`) — Unified Admin Panel by Revlet (`https://revlet.me`)

## Overview
Revlet brings professional business email, global domain DNS management, and team access control together in one clean platform. Organizations start free during Open Access at `$0/month` for up to 1,000 custom mailboxes.

## Core Capabilities
- **Custom Domain Business Email (`/services/email`)**: Provision up to 1,000 `@yourcompany.com` mailboxes, up to 25 aliases per mailbox, 50 Organizational Units, bulk CSV onboarding (200 rows per upload), unlimited incoming email, and 1,000 monthly outbound emails per organization. Automated checks for `MX`, `SPF`, `DKIM`, and `DMARC` plus 14-day soft-delete recovery.
- **Shared Team Mailboxes**: Manage team addresses (`hello@`, `support@`, `billing@`) using individual staff sign-ins and synced sent folders without password sharing.
- **Cloud DNS Management (`/services/dns`)**: Sub-second global updates across 16 record types, BIND zone file import/export, zero-billing Cloudflare integration or external registrar verification, and 1-click snapshot rollback.
- **Team Permissions (`/management/team`)**: Scoped per-organization access across `Admin`, DNS, and Email roles.
